scope: Synthetic rules-only prototypes. Does not measure the released optional-decider path.
methodology: Five paired repetitions per workload, fresh workspaces and sessions, identical fixtures per pair, counterbalanced variant order, strict JSON answers and tool-use audit.

workloads.verified: Five of five model-visible lookup outputs were byte-identical to baseline.

limitations: Not a real-repository benchmark or a general performance guarantee.
Cumulative input includes prompt-cache hits on every request.
No cache reset; model/network latency and user plugins affect time and credits.
No benchmark of MCP, compaction, learned keep or multi-turn implementation tasks.
Rules-only measurements predate the production adapter and its optional-decider integration.
